display.title: Diamond Armor
display.subtitle: Diamond armor opens at Tier 3
description: Suit up. A full set of diamond armor is the baseline for surviving the
mid-tiers, though the modular Tetra and Iridescent armor systems will soon
outclass it. This quest completes when the Codex grants you Tier 3.
§7Mind the death penalty: gear goes inert rather than vanishing.
